$comment: Input to tools/scaffold-feature.js. Components marked hand:true have been rewritten by hand since generation; the scaffolder never overwrites an existing file without --force, so leave them be.

dashboard.description: Landing page after sign-in. Tiles are independent so one failing BFF call does not blank the page (MOL-2760).

components.name: dashboard-overview
components.title: Dashboard
components.purpose: Composes the dashboard tiles; owns the greeting and the tile layout.

components.name: accounts-summary
components.title: Your accounts
components.purpose: Compact account list with balances for the dashboard.

components.name: recent-activity
components.title: Recent activity
components.purpose: Last ten transactions across all accounts.

components.name: quick-transfer
components.title: Quick transfer
components.purpose: One-step transfer between the customer's own accounts, under the MFA threshold only.

components.name: spending-snapshot
components.title: Spending this month
components.purpose: Doughnut chart of spend by category for the current month.

components.name: upcoming-payments
components.title: Coming up
components.purpose: Scheduled transfers and bills due in the next 14 days.

components.name: alerts-digest
components.title: Alerts
components.purpose: Unread alerts since last sign-in.

components.name: promo-banner
components.purpose: Marketing slot fed by Semaphore flag mol.dashboard.promo; hidden when the flag is off.
paragraphs: Earn 4.10% APY on a Meridian Reserve Savings account. Rates as of today; see disclosures for details.

accounts.description: Account list, detail and transaction history. The most-visited surface after the dashboard.

components.name: account-list
components.title: Accounts
components.lede: Balances refresh each time you open this page.
components.emptyTitle: You have no accounts with us yet
components.purpose: All accounts grouped by type with current and available balances.

components.name: account-detail
components.title: Account
components.purpose: Detail header with balances, routing details, actions and the transaction list.

components.name: transaction-list
components.title: Transactions
components.purpose: Filterable, paged transaction list for one account. Used inside account detail.

components.name: transaction-detail
components.title: Transaction
components.purpose: Single transaction with merchant, status, running balance and dispute entry point.

components.name: transaction-filters
components.title: Filters
components.purpose: Date range, category, amount and search filters for the transaction list.

components.name: account-actions-menu
components.title: Actions
components.purpose: Transfer, statements, rename, paperless and routing details entry points for an account.

components.name: routing-details
components.title: Account and routing numbers
components.purpose: Reveals routing and full account number for direct deposit forms.

components.name: rename-account
components.title: Rename account
components.body: Nicknames only show in Meridian Online and the mobile app. Statements keep the product name.
components.purpose: Nickname editor dialog.

components.name: dispute-transaction
components.title: Dispute a transaction
components.lede: We will credit your account while we investigate, usually within 2 business days.
components.successToast: Dispute submitted. We will email you a reference within 24 hours.
components.purpose: Reg E dispute intake form.

options.label: I did not make this purchase
I did not receive what I paid for

components.name: export-transactions
components.title: Download transactions
components.body: Downloads the transactions matching your current filters as a CSV file. Files open in most spreadsheet software.
components.confirmCall: this.api.exportCsv({ accountId: this.data.accountId, from: this.data.from, to: this.data.to, page: 1, pageSize: 5000 })
components.purpose: CSV export confirmation.

components.name: pending-transactions
components.title: Pending
components.purpose: Pending card authorisations shown above posted transactions.

components.name: interest-summary
components.title: Interest
components.purpose: Year-to-date interest earned or charged, from the account details.
paragraphs: Interest is calculated daily and paid on the last business day of each month. Year-to-date figures are shown on your statement and on your 1099-INT in January.

transfers.description: Move money: internal, external (ACH) and PayLink. Compliance-critical; anything above the configured threshold needs MFA step-up (MfaStepUpGuard).

components.name: transfers-home
components.title: Transfers
components.purpose: Landing: new transfer entry points, scheduled list and recent history tabs.

components.name: transfer-wizard
components.title: New transfer
components.purpose: Stepper shell for the transfer flow; owns the draft and parks the amount for the MFA guard.

components.name: transfer-details-step
components.title: Details
components.purpose: From, to, amount and memo. Typed reactive form.

components.name: transfer-schedule-step
components.title: Schedule
components.purpose: Date and frequency with cutoff handling.

components.name: transfer-review-step
components.title: Review
components.purpose: Read-back before submit. Behind MfaStepUpGuard.

components.name: transfer-confirmation
components.title: Transfer confirmed
components.purpose: Confirmation number, arrival estimate and next actions.

components.name: scheduled-transfers
components.title: Scheduled
components.emptyBody: Recurring transfers you set up will appear here.
components.purpose: Upcoming one-off and recurring transfers.

components.name: transfer-history
components.title: Transfer history
components.lede: Up to 24 months of transfers. Older activity is on your statements.
components.purpose: Completed and failed transfers.

components.name: transfer-detail
components.title: Transfer
components.purpose: One scheduled or completed transfer, with cancel where still allowed.

components.name: cancel-transfer
components.title: Cancel this transfer?
components.body: The transfer will not be sent. If it is part of a recurring series, only this occurrence is cancelled.
components.purpose: Cancel confirmation for a scheduled transfer.

components.name: payee-list
components.title: External accounts and people
components.purpose: External transfer payees with verification status.

components.name: add-payee
components.title: Add an external account
components.lede: We will send two small deposits to verify the account. This usually takes 1-2 business days.
components.successToast: Account added. Watch for two small deposits to verify it.
components.purpose: External account (ACH) payee entry. Always requires MFA step-up.
components.submitCall: this.api.addPayee({ name: this.form.value.name ?? '', nickname: this.form.value.nickname ?? '', routingNumber: this.form.value.routingNumber ?? '', accountNumber: this.form.value.accountNumber ?? '', accountNumberLastFour: (this.form.value.accountNumber ?? '').slice(-4), type: 'external-transfer' })

components.name: verify-payee
components.title: Verify external account
components.lede: Enter the two deposit amounts that appeared on the other account. You have three attempts.
components.successToast: Account verified. You can transfer to it now.
components.purpose: Micro-deposit verification.

components.name: transfer-limits-panel
components.title: Your limits
components.purpose: Daily external limit and remaining amount, shown beside the wizard.
paragraphs: External transfers are limited per day and per transaction. Limits reset at midnight Eastern. Transfers submitted after the 5:00 PM ET cutoff are processed the next business day.

bill-pay.description: Bill payments to registered payees, eBills and autopay. Runs on the same payments rail as transfers.

components.name: bill-pay-home
components.title: Bill pay
components.lede: Bills due in the next 30 days. eBills update automatically.
components.emptyBody: Add a payee to start paying bills from Meridian Online.
components.purpose: Bills due, with pay-now entry points.

components.name: bill-detail
components.title: Bill
components.purpose: One bill with eBill and autopay status.

components.name: pay-bill
components.title: Pay a bill
components.lede: Payments sent before 5:00 PM ET are processed the same business day.
components.purpose: Schedule a single payment. Typed form; behind MfaStepUpGuard for high amounts.
components.submitCall: this.api.schedule({ payeeId: this.router.url.split('/')[3], fromAccountId: this.form.value.fromAccountId ?? '', amountMinor: this.form.value.amountMinor ?? 0, sendOn: this.form.value.sendOn ?? this.today, memo: this.form.value.memo ?? undefined, idempotencyKey: crypto.randomUUID() })

components.name: scheduled-payments
components.title: Scheduled payments
components.purpose: Payments queued to send.

components.name: payment-history
components.title: Payment history
components.purpose: Sent payments, 24 months.

components.name: add-bill-payee
components.title: Add a payee
components.lede: Search our directory first; payees found there receive electronic payments, usually within 2 business days.
components.purpose: Bill pay payee entry (directory or manual).

fields.name: accountNumber
fields.label: Your account number with the payee

components.name: autopay-settings
components.title: Autopay
components.lede: We pay the amount due on the due date. You can cancel a scheduled autopay up to the business day before.
components.purpose: Autopay toggle and funding account.

components.name: cancel-payment
components.title: Cancel this payment?
components.body: The payee will not receive this payment. Any late fees are between you and the payee.
components.purpose: Cancel a scheduled payment.

cards.description: Debit and credit card servicing: lock, controls, travel notices, replacements. Some of this predates the RxJS 7 upgrade.

components.name: card-list
components.title: Cards
components.purpose: All cards with status and quick lock.

components.name: card-detail
components.title: Card
components.purpose: Card artwork, status, controls entry and reveal.

components.name: card-controls
components.title: Card controls
components.purpose: Per-card spend controls.

components.name: lock-card
components.title: Lock this card?
components.body: Locked cards decline new purchases and ATM withdrawals. Recurring payments you already set up still go through. Unlock any time.
components.purpose: Lock/unlock confirmation.

components.name: report-card
components.title: Report lost, stolen or damaged
components.lede: We cancel the card immediately and send a replacement to your address on file within 5-7 business days.
components.successToast: Card cancelled. Your replacement is on its way.
components.purpose: Lost/stolen intake.

fields.name: lastSeen
fields.label: When did you last have it?

components.name: travel-notice
components.title: Travel notice
components.lede: Tell us where you are going so purchases abroad are not flagged as unusual.
components.successToast: Travel notice saved. Have a good trip.
components.purpose: Travel notice entry.

components.name: activate-card
components.title: Activate your card
components.purpose: New card activation.

statements.description: Statements, tax documents and paperless preferences. PDFs are streamed from bff-retail, never cached by the SW.

components.name: statement-list
components.title: Statements and documents
components.purpose: Statements by account and year with download.

components.name: tax-documents
components.title: Tax documents
components.purpose: 1099-INT and 1098 forms by tax year.

components.name: paperless-settings
components.title: Paperless
components.purpose: Per-account paperless enrolment.

components.name: statement-viewer
components.title: Statement
components.purpose: In-page PDF viewer with download.

components.name: document-search
components.title: Find a document
components.purpose: Search across statements, notices and tax forms.
paragraphs: Search by account, year or document type. Notices such as rate changes and privacy policy updates are kept for 7 years.

alerts.description: Alert preferences (regulatory and optional), delivery channels, quiet hours and alert history.

components.name: alerts-home
components.title: Alerts
components.purpose: Tabs: preferences and history.

components.name: alert-preferences
components.title: Alert preferences
components.purpose: Grouped alert toggles with channel selection and thresholds; regulatory alerts cannot be disabled.

components.name: alert-preference-row
components.title: Alert
components.purpose: One alert: toggle, channels, threshold.

components.name: channel-picker
components.title: Channels
components.purpose: Push / SMS / email / in-app chips, with SMS requiring a verified mobile.

components.name: quiet-hours
components.title: Quiet hours
components.purpose: Do-not-disturb window for non-regulatory alerts.

components.name: alert-history
components.title: Alert history
components.purpose: Alerts sent in the last 90 days.

components.name: test-alert
components.title: Send a test alert
components.body: We will send a test message to the selected channel so you can check it arrives. It may take a minute.
components.purpose: Channel test dialog.

profile.description: Contact details, address, security settings, devices and login history. Uses the untyped forms API pending MOL-4471.

components.name: profile-home
components.title: Profile and security
components.purpose: Overview with contact summary and security posture.

components.name: contact-details
components.title: Contact details
components.lede: We use these for alerts and to verify it is you. Changing your mobile number re-verifies SMS alerts.
components.purpose: Email, mobile, language and paperless. Untyped form.

components.name: address-form
components.title: Mailing address
components.lede: Cards and paper statements go here. A new address takes effect after we verify it, usually within 1 business day.
components.purpose: Address editor. Untyped form.

components.name: security-settings
components.title: Security
components.purpose: MFA method, password age, username, devices, login history.

components.name: change-password
components.title: Change password
components.purpose: Password change with strength rules. Untyped form.

components.name: change-username
components.title: Change username
components.lede: Usernames are 8-30 characters, letters and numbers only, and can be changed once every 90 days.
components.successToast: Username changed. Use it next time you sign in.
components.purpose: Username change. Untyped form.

components.name: mfa-settings
components.title: Two-step verification
components.purpose: Choose SMS, authenticator or push.

components.name: trusted-devices
components.title: Trusted devices
components.purpose: Devices that skip step-up; remove any.

components.name: login-history
components.title: Sign-in activity
components.purpose: Recent sign-ins with location and device.

messages.description: Secure messaging with the contact centre. Behind flag mol.secure-messages.enabled.

components.name: thread-list
components.title: Secure messages
components.lede: We reply within 1 business day. For anything urgent, call the number on the back of your card.
components.emptyBody: Start a conversation and we will get back to you within a business day.
components.purpose: Conversation list.

components.name: thread-view
components.title: Conversation
components.purpose: Messages in a thread with reply box.

components.name: compose-message
components.title: New message
components.lede: Do not include your full card number or password. We will never ask for them here.
components.successToast: Message sent. We will reply within 1 business day.
components.purpose: Compose a new thread.

components.name: message-bubble
components.title: Message
components.purpose: One message in a thread.

rewards.description: Meridian Rewards points balance and redemption. Behind flag mol.rewards.enabled; credit card customers only.

components.name: rewards-summary
components.title: Rewards
components.purpose: Points balance, tier and expiring points.

components.name: rewards-activity
components.title: Points activity
components.purpose: Points earned and redeemed.

components.name: redeem-points
components.title: Redeem points
components.lede: Statement credits post within 2 business days. Deposits to a Meridian account are same day.
components.purpose: Redemption form.

onboarding.description: Open an account, unauthenticated. Untyped forms; the flow predates typed forms and shares validators with the 2021 marketing site.

components.name: onboarding-start
components.title: Open an account
components.lede: Takes about 10 minutes. You will need a government ID and your Social Security number.
components.purpose: Product choice entry.
paragraphs: Choose a checking or savings account to get started. You can add more accounts once you are a customer.
Applications are subject to identity verification. We may ask for additional documents.

components.name: identity-step
components.title: About you
components.lede: Enter your name exactly as it appears on your ID.
components.purpose: Legal name, DOB, SSN (masked). Untyped form.

components.name: contact-step
components.title: How to reach you
components.purpose: Email, mobile and address. Untyped form.

components.name: product-step
components.title: Choose your account
components.purpose: Product and options. Untyped form.

options.label: Everyday Checking - no monthly fee with direct deposit
Premier Checking - interest bearing, $25 monthly fee waivable

components.name: funding-step
components.title: Fund your account
components.lede: Minimum opening deposit is $25. You can fund from another bank account or skip and fund later.
components.purpose: Initial deposit. Untyped form.

components.name: review-step
components.title: Review and submit
components.purpose: Read-back and agreements before submission.
paragraphs: Check everything below. By submitting you agree to the Deposit Account Agreement, the Electronic Communications Consent and our Privacy Notice.
We will email you a decision, usually within a few minutes. Some applications need a manual review, which can take up to 2 business days.

help.description: Help centre. Public. Content from the BFF's CMS proxy.

components.name: help-home
components.title: Help
components.lede: Answers to common questions. Still stuck? Send us a secure message or call us.
components.purpose: Help landing with topics.
paragraphs: Browse by topic or search. Articles are updated by the Digital Support team; if something is wrong or missing, use the feedback link at the bottom of any article.

components.name: faq
components.title: Frequently asked questions
components.purpose: FAQ accordion.
paragraphs: How long do transfers take? Transfers between your Meridian accounts are immediate. External transfers take 1-3 business days depending on the receiving bank.
Why was I signed out? For your security we end sessions after 10 minutes without activity. Your work is not saved when this happens.
How do I dispute a charge? Open the transaction and choose Dispute. You have 60 days from the statement date.

components.name: contact-us
components.title: Contact us
components.purpose: Phone numbers, hours and secure message link.
paragraphs: Hearing or speech impaired: dial 711 then the number above.

disclosures.description: Regulatory disclosures. Content versions come from the BFF; Legal owns the text (LGL-COMMS mailbox).

components.name: disclosure-list
components.title: Disclosures and agreements
components.purpose: Index of agreements with effective dates.
paragraphs: Current versions of the agreements that govern your accounts. Prior versions are available on request from Customer Care.

components.name: disclosure-viewer
components.title: Disclosure
components.purpose: Renders one disclosure by key via cn-disclosure.

errors.description: Not found, forbidden and generic error pages. Wildcard route lives here.

components.name: not-found
components.title: We could not find that page
paragraphs: The link may be out of date, or the page may have moved. Check the address or start again from your dashboard.

components.name: forbidden
components.title: You do not have access to this
paragraphs: This feature is not available on your accounts. If you think it should be, send us a secure message and we will take a look.

components.name: generic-error
components.title: Something went wrong
components.purpose: Catch-all error page, also the chunk-load fallback.
paragraphs: We hit a problem loading this page. Nothing has changed on your accounts. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, call us and quote the reference on this page.
